description: This Java class `SensorCentral` manages sensor values and listeners within a larger embedded or vehicle control system. It provides methods to get/set sensor values, add/remove listeners, initialize sensor mappings, and handle updates. It implements the `ISensorCentral` interface and maintains internal state relating to sensors and event listeners.

classes.name: SensorCentral
classes.description: Main class responsible for sensor value management, listener notification, and initialization for sensors in the system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SensorCentral.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes sensor values from the EngineState.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specified sensor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for a specified sensor and notifies listeners.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: setAnySensorListener
methods.description: Sets a listener that is notified on any sensor update.
